thread:
Maya (Design): quick design drop — working on a smaller footprint for the p95 + heatmap card, and an inline sampling control + clipboard CTA for quick export. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/latency-cards

Maya (Design): main ask: does the inline sampling toggle feel discoverable when collapsed? also thinking about making the clipboard/export button primary in compact mode — but worried it competes with the timepicker. :thinking:

Kevin (Eng): saw the figma, looks tight. my only perf worry is adding another interactive in the small card might increase tab stops and keyboard travel. can we collapse sampling into a single icon that opens a popover?

Ava (PM): love the clipboard CTA for ops — makes it easier to grab a quick CSV for incident triage. maybe we make clipboard primary only when the card is pinned or in expanded state?

Jules (Accessibility): quick a11y nits: if inline sampling is an icon-only control, ensure aria-label includes current sampling rate (e.g., "Sampling: 1/10"). keyboard focus needs visible outline at 2px contrast against card bg. also check color contrast of heatmap legend buckets.

Maya (Design): good call — plan B was icon + microlabel when collapsed. example: "Samp 1/10". thoughts on copying that to clipboard CTA: show a tooltip "Copy visible range" on hover and include aria-live announcement on success?

Kevin (Eng): aria-live for success is fine. implementation note: prefer an unobtrusive toast from console-bot rather than mutating the DOM text. also we can reuse existing clipboard util: 

```
navigator.clipboard.writeText(csv)
```

Ava (PM): +1 for toast. also we should gate the clipboard CTA behind a tiny throttle to avoid spammy copies during incident chaos. maybe 1 copy / 5s?

Jules (Accessibility): tooltip text should be explicit: "Copy visible timeframe data as CSV (rows limited to 10k)". and for the sampling icon: ensure it has role=button and aria-pressed for on/off states. example attribute suggestions: `role="button" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Sampling: off"`

Maya (Design): nice, I'll update the hiccup states. another layout question: do we move timepicker to the right edge in compact mode so clipboard sits next to it, or keep timepicker left and clipboard right?

Kevin (Eng): keep timepicker left feels more discoverable (users scan left-to-right). moving it might break alignment with other panels. if we need to save horizontal space, collapse date-range text into an icon+tooltip instead of moving it.

Ava (PM): agree with Kevin. also add a microcopy change: change "Auto-sample" to "Adaptive sampling" in the tooltip — it's clearer to end users.

Maya (Design): adaptive sampling microcopy adopted. small preview of the compact card w/ tooltip attached: https://img.redwood.com/preview/latency-compact-clip.png

Jules (Accessibility): last thing — colorblindness: use both pattern + color in heatmap legend (dot pattern overlays), and ensure the hover tooltip for p95 has `aria-describedby` linking to the exact percentile label.

Kevin (Eng): impl plan: icon-only sampling button that opens popover with slider + quick presets. clipboard button triggers existing copy util + toast. timepicker stays left. should be doable in one sprint if design provides assets.

Maya (Design): ok will update figma with icon states, microcopy, and the tooltip strings. will add a11y notes in the spec. thanks y'all. :thumbsup:

console-bot: Copied 3 files to staging-assets/latency/compact/ (build 2026-03-23T15:12Z)

Ava (PM): quick follow-up — add a small analytics event for `compact_clipboard_clicked` with a sampling_rate tag so we can see usage vs sampling mode. low entropy props only.

Kevin (Eng): ack, will add event and throttle on the UI side.

Maya (Design): will ping when figma is updated. if anyone wants to pair on the a11y copy, @Jules please join.

Jules (Accessibility): happy to, ping me :)

Maya (Design): end.
